verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime handles user audio, video, and data, and it offers AI transcription and summaries, so a policy or control against using that data for AI training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no statement, setting, or policy about AI-training use of customer data or any opt-out. The community privacy comments concern metadata and end-to-end encryption, not model training, so they do not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
